workload: QuantTrio/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-AWQ + vLLM + ROCm 10 + Radeon AI PRO R9700/gfx1201 + MoE + W4A16

preserve_contracts.reason: The prototype targets the normalized MoeWNA16Config AWQ path. Removing the direct AutoAWQConfig rejection would broaden support beyond the validated layout and is not required for this workload.

prototype_edits.design: Port the #43389 pure-tensor helpers: [E,N,K//2] uint8 -> [E,K,N//8] int32 and packed int4 zero points -> [E,K_groups,N] fp16.

Inside convert_to_wna16_moe_kernel_format only, repack int4 MoeWNA16Config tensors on RDNA after the AWQ loader has normalized them. Transpose scales and unpack zero points per tensor when N is divisible by 8. Do not remove the direct AutoAWQConfig incompatibility guard in _backend_incompatibility_reason.
Add an explicit layout predicate for int4 weights repacked as int32 so downstream code does not infer layout from platform alone.
Derive N from scales for [E,K,N//8] int32 layout, use the correct hidden-size assertion, and pass layout state into config selection/kernel invocation without changing backend priority or defaults.
Port the #43389 interleave-aware pointer, stride, zero-point and N-shape logic behind an explicit int4-interleaved flag. Preserve the existing non-interleaved path unchanged.

gpu_required_before_any_runtime_candidat: Build/import candidate against the chosen vLLM ref on ROCm 10 + gfx1201.
Load QuantTrio/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-AWQ through the normalized MoeWNA16Config path and prove Triton backend selection.
Verify repacked w13/w2 shapes, scale shapes and asymmetric zero-point layout before first inference.
Run exact correctness/hash regression against the preserved S3 reference contract.
Measure new-version TTFT/decode/throughput only after correctness passes; this is a migration gate, not a replay of Phases 2-6.
Exercise fail-closed startup and stock fallback without replacing the preserved S3 service until the new lane passes all gates.
